name: battery_strength
kind: coverage diagnostic / calibration battery
computes: Given per-member verdict columns over the same candidate set, reports how many advertised battery members actually discriminate (non-constant column, entropy > 0 bits) and names the silent ones.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.battery import battery_strength; s = battery_strength({"F9":[1,1,1], "F11":[0,0,0], "F3":[1,0,1]}); print(s.report())`
inputs: dict[str, list[bool|None]] -- one column per falsifier/member, one row per candidate
outputs: BatteryStrength(advertised, discriminating, silent_members, total_bits, report()) -- e.g. "battery of 2 advertised, 1 discriminating over 3 candidates; silent: b"
evidence_of_execution: tests/test_battery.py::test_composes_with_the_real_discovery_battery_audit pins cycle-028 live measurement (4 advertised / 2 discriminating / silent F9, F11 on the discovery pipeline kill path); no standalone result artefact
control: tests/test_battery.py (15 tests): constant columns -> silent; mixed columns -> discriminating; smoke run: {'a':[1,0,1],'b':[0,0,0]} -> 1 discriminating, silent ['b']
forensic_use: Answer "was this organism's kill battery ever able to kill anything?" from its logged verdict columns alone -- an all-constant column means the gate was decorative, not that the organism passed.
caveat: None entries are treated as a third value, so a member that always errored looks "discriminating" if mixed with successes; inspect silent_members AND the error rate.

name: structural_constancy
kind: invariant checker / anti-cheat
computes: Decides whether a predicate is PARAMETER_INDEPENDENT (AST shows it never reads its args, or no flipping input found), VARIES (a flipping input pair exists), UNSETTLED, or INVALID_PROBE.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.battery import structural_constancy; structural_constancy("g", lambda x: x > 1, inputs=[0,1,2,3], fn_for_source=None)`
inputs: a callable predicate, an iterable of probe inputs, optional source-bearing function for the static tier
evidence_of_execution: consumed by techne/ladder_circuits/constancy_sweep.py (cycle 029); smoke: const lambda -> PARAMETER_INDEPENDENT, x>1 -> VARIES
control: tests/test_battery.py::test_reads_its_parameters_static_tier and the cycle-029 block (static tier vs dynamic tier, both directions)
forensic_use: Test a dead agent's "verifier" without running the agent: if the verifier is parameter-independent, every PASS it ever emitted was vacuous.
caveat: The AST tier reads source text only; a function that reads parameters via **kwargs/globals is reported UNSETTLED not PARAMETER_INDEPENDENT. Lambdas defined in `python -c` have no retrievable source -> dynamic tier only.

name: murphy_decomposition
kind: calibration battery / scorer
computes: Murphy partition of the Brier score into reliability, resolution, uncertainty; .skill = 1 - Brier/uncertainty, raising CalibrationError when the label set is degenerate (uncertainty == 0).
invocation: `from prometheus_math.calibration import murphy_decomposition; m = murphy_decomposition(probs=[0.7,0.2,0.9], labels=[1,0,1], bins=10); print(m.brier, m.reliability, m.resolution, m.skill_or(None))`
inputs: parallel sequences of forecast probabilities and 0/1 labels
outputs: MurphyPartition(brier, reliability, resolution, uncertainty, skill, skill_or(default), identity_residual)
evidence_of_execution: consumed by techne/ladder_circuits/canon_r11_calibration.py (covered path) and contract_registry.py; no standalone artefact
control: tests/test_calibration.py (10 tests): base-rate forecaster has skill exactly 0; degenerate labels raise; identity residual ~0. Smoke run reproduced skill 0.0 for base-rate forecaster.
forensic_use: Grade any dead agent's logged confidence stream against outcomes; skill <= 0 with resolution ~0 means it never carried information beyond the base rate (a chance-floor finding without resurrecting the agent).
caveat: Refuses (raises) on single-class label sets -- a common shape in dead-agent logs where every outcome was FAIL; use skill_or() and report the refusal, do not silently drop.

name: degenerate_audit
kind: negative control / invariant checker
computes: For every measure-like function in given modules, feeds degenerate inputs (empty, single-class, constant) and classifies REFUSES / CONFLATES (returns a value indistinguishable from a real measurement) / DISTINGUISHES / UNPROBED.
invocation: `from prometheus_math import degenerate_audit as d, battery, calibration; rows = d.audit_modules([battery, calibration]); [print(r.name, r.verdict) for r in rows]`
inputs: python module objects (default MEASURE_MODULES = 11 prometheus_math modules)
evidence_of_execution: tests pin the live census (test_THE_DENOMINATOR_IS_FORTY, test_the_class_now_stands_at_TEN_of_FORTY); smoke on battery+calibration: member_resolution REFUSES, reads_its_parameters CONFLATES, brier_score REFUSES, expected_calibration_error REFUSES
control: tests/test_degenerate_audit.py (9 tests) includes a known-conflating fixture and a known-refusing fixture
forensic_use: Run over a dead agent's own scoring module to find scorers that return a clean number on empty/constant input -- the classic way an idle loop reports "health".
caveat: The denominator (40) and the 10/40 count are pinned to prometheus_math's own module list; running it on other packages gives a different census and the pinned tests are not a control for that.

name: mechanism_audit
kind: failure classifier
computes: Classifies the source idiom behind each CONFLATES site (VACUOUS_QUANTIFIER / EMPTY_ITERATION_SENTINEL / ARITHMETIC_IDENTITY / INHERITED / NO_IDIOM), builds a confusion matrix of "idiom predicts conflation", and traces provenance to root sites with a propagation factor.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.mechanism_audit import predicts_conflation, provenance; print(predicts_conflation()); print(provenance())`
inputs: source of THE_TEN pinned sites (reads via inspect.getsource), degenerate_audit rows
outputs: Prediction(confusion matrix), provenance dict {roots, exposed_sites, propagation_factor}
evidence_of_execution: NONE FOUND beyond its tests (no .md artefact)
control: tests/test_mechanism_audit.py (site list pinned; each of the 5 idioms has a positive fixture)
forensic_use: Given a scorer that conflates, name the code idiom responsible (e.g. `all([])` is True) so the Necropolis verdict can say "this agent's verifier passed because of a vacuous quantifier", with a reproducible source citation.
caveat: THE_TEN is a hardcoded list of prometheus_math sites; classify_mechanism is reusable on arbitrary source text but the prediction matrix is not.

name: instrument_contract_certify
kind: calibration battery / anti-cheat
computes: Certifies an instrument against a contract of positive fixtures (must signal), negative fixtures (must not), invalid fixtures (must refuse), and a sensitivity draw (must change output under perturbation); .admissible only if all four hold.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.instrument_contract import InstrumentContract, certify; c = InstrumentContract(name="x", positive=[...], negative=[...], invalid=[...], sensitivity=draw_fn, is_signal=f, is_no_signal=g); r = certify(instrument, c, draws=3); print(r.admissible, r.failures)`
inputs: callable instrument, fixture lists, predicate functions
outputs: CertificationReport(positive_ok, negative_ok, invalid_ok, sensitive, admissible, failures)
evidence_of_execution: techne/ladder_circuits/contract_registry.py registers live contracts; tests reference RETRO cycles 029/032/033/034
control: tests/test_instrument_contract.py (11 tests): a memorising instrument fails sensitivity; a constant instrument fails negative; `memorisation_is_still_possible` documents the residual hole
forensic_use: Re-certify a dead agent's grader post-mortem using the fixtures it should have been able to pass; an inadmissible grader explains a whole lineage of "green" runs.
caveat: `memorisation_is_still_possible` is explicit in the module: an instrument that memorises the fixture set passes; pair with adversarial_fixtures.

name: adversarial_fixtures
kind: falsifier / property-based test
computes: Hypothesis-driven search for an input that violates a declared invariant of an instrument; returns the first Violation (input, observed) or None after max_examples.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.adversarial_fixtures import InvariantSpec, search_for_violation; v = search_for_violation(InvariantSpec(instrument=f, invariant="symmetry", check=lambda x,y: ..., draw=strategy), max_examples=300)`
control: tests/test_adversarial_fixtures.py: a deliberately asymmetric instrument yields a Violation; a correct one yields None
forensic_use: Attack a dead agent's scorer with generated inputs to find the input class it mis-scored, without the agent's loop.
caveat: None after 300 examples is not proof; Hypothesis shrinking may report a trivial input that hides the interesting violation class.

name: migration_liveness
kind: coverage diagnostic / liveness probe
computes: Wraps 10 target call sites with probes and reports each LIVE (reached) or UNREACHED, attributing reaches to FROM_TEST vs FROM_PROD by call-stack inspection.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.migration_liveness import install_probes, summarise; recs=[]; install_probes(recs); ...exercise code...; print(summarise(recs))`
evidence_of_execution: only measured under test-suite runs (which this scout may not run); NONE FOUND as artefact
control: tests/test_migration_liveness.py: a probe on a never-called site reports UNREACHED
forensic_use: Pattern for "was this code path ever reached in production or only from tests" -- directly the Pronoia/Necropolis L0-L5 question; TARGETS is easily re-pointed.
caveat: Measures only what runs in the same process while probes are installed; it cannot retro-read a dead agent's history.

name: measurement_and_partition
kind: invariant checker / three-valued measurement type
computes: Measurement forbids bool() coercion and raises on .value when OUT_OF_DOMAIN (reason mandatory); partition.py computes entropy/MI/VI (Meila 2007) between labelings and whether a chain of partitions is a refinement chain, returning Measurement not floats.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.partition import variation_of_information, refines; variation_of_information([0,0,1,1],[0,1,0,1])`; `from prometheus_math.measurement import out_of_domain; m = out_of_domain("empty"); m.value  # raises`
evidence_of_execution: consumed by battery.py and by adjusted_rand.py, fowlkes_mallows.py, mirkin_metric.py, normalized_mi.py
control: tests/test_measurement.py (12) -- __bool__ always raises; tests/test_partition.py -- identical partitions VI=0, refinement direction detected
forensic_use: Compare a dead agent's cell/niche labeling to a ground-truth labeling (VI in bits); the Measurement type prevents "None == 0.0 == PASS" conflations when re-reading logs.
caveat: Small instruments; useful as the safe substrate under other harvest tools rather than as a stand-alone verdict.

name: relative_claim_monotonicity
kind: invariant checker / claim classifier
computes: Runs a measure over a chain of nested domains and classifies the claim as EXISTENTIAL / UNIVERSAL / INVARIANT / AGGREGATE from how the measure moves under domain growth.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.relative_claim import probe_monotonicity; probe_monotonicity(measure=fn, chain=[Domain(...), Domain(...), ...])`
inputs: callable measure, list of Domain objects forming a refinement chain
control: tests/test_relative_claim.py: max-over-domain is EXISTENTIAL, mean is AGGREGATE, constant is INVARIANT
forensic_use: Decide whether a dead lane's headline number ("coverage 19%") was a domain-relative aggregate that would move under a bigger reference class -- the base-rate-null question in code form.
caveat: Needs the caller to construct the domain chain; wrong chain -> wrong kind.

name: bootstrap_matched_null
kind: null generator / permutation-bootstrap / statistical test
computes: Two-sided p-value of an observation against a caller-supplied null generator (p = 2*min(P(null>=obs),P(null<=obs)) clipped to [1/(n+1),1]) with z-score; label-permutation test between two samples; percentile bootstrap CI; Holm-Bonferroni family correction.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.research.bootstrap import matched_null_test, permutation_test, holm_bonferroni; matched_null_test(obs, null_fn=lambda rng: ..., n=10000, statistic="mean", seed=0); permutation_test(a, b, statistic="diff_mean", n=2000, seed=1); holm_bonferroni([0.01,0.04,0.2])`
outputs: dicts with observed/null_mean/null_std/p_value/z_score/null_distribution; list of adjusted p / reject flags
evidence_of_execution: consumed by research/tensor.py and statistics_distributions.py; no standalone artefact
control: research/tests/test_bootstrap.py (21 tests): authority H0 gives p ~ uniform, H1 rejects; Holm worked example matches published; matches scipy permutation. Smoke: permutation_test([1,2,3,4],[10,11,12,13], n=200, seed=1) -> p=0.0348
forensic_use: Generic engine for "did this dead experiment's effect survive a matched null?" -- feed its logged statistic and a null built from its own archive (e.g. block-shuffle).
caveat: p floor is 1/(n+1); a result at exactly the floor means "null never reached it", not "p=0". holm_bonferroni assumes the p list is complete -- omitted tests inflate significance.

name: anomaly_surface_ks
kind: statistical test / differential test against reference ensembles
computes: KS two-sample p of a spacing-ratio sample against cached Monte-Carlo Poisson/GOE/GUE/GSE reference ratios (Atas et al. 2013 r-tilde); best_match ensemble and anomaly_score = -log10(max p); surface_anomalies flags series failing all classes.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.research.anomaly_surface import classify_against_ensembles, surface_anomalies; classify_against_ensembles(ratios); surface_anomalies(None, zeros_records=[{"label":"x","zeros":[...]}], p_threshold=0.05)`
inputs: ratio arrays; or zeros_records=[{label, zeros}] (bypasses LMFDB); family_query path uses LMFDB (network -- avoid)
outputs: dict {ensemble: p, best_match, distance_to_best, data_mean_r}; list of anomaly dicts
control: 18 tests incl. test_composition_surface_anomalies_flags_when_all_classes_fail (positive) and zeta->GUE (negative/authority)
forensic_use: Reference-ensemble classifier for any spectral/spacing claim in a dead Harmonia lane (e.g. the GUE-deviation z=-19 POSSIBLE finding) -- re-test from stored zeros without the pipeline.
caveat: mode="asymp" KS; reference sample is cached MC with fixed seed, so p-values are relative to that draw. Smoke classifying uniform ratios as GOE shows "best_match" is always populated -- read the p, not the label.

name: spectral_gaps_matched_null
kind: null generator / statistical test
computes: Generates normalized k-gap spacings from GUE/GOE/GSE/CUE/O+/O- random matrices of size N (kmax up to 24); bootstrap_ci returns deficit = 1 - var/var_null with two-sided p against the null sample.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.research.spectral_gaps import matched_null, bootstrap_ci; null = matched_null(N=200, n_samples=200, ensemble="GUE", kmax=8, rng=np.random.default_rng(0)); bootstrap_ci(values, null[:,k], n_bootstrap=10000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=2024)`
inputs: zero lists / numpy arrays; scan() uses LMFDB (network -- avoid)
evidence_of_execution: research/tests/test_spectral_gaps.py (11) incl. authority Wigner-surmise GUE variance and USp4 != GUE
control: authority variance test (right case) and USp4 discrimination (wrong case); composition test on 30 synthetic curves
forensic_use: The matched-null generator behind the "spectral tail killed / NF backbone downgraded" Harmonia findings; re-run a dead finding's deficit against a fresh null with a different seed to test seed-dependence.
caveat: Random-matrix nulls are O(N^3) per sample; N=200 x 10000 samples is minutes. Default rng_seed=2024 in bootstrap_ci -- vary it or the CI is a single draw.

name: mahler_lookup_factored
kind: exact-match / symbolic oracle against catalog
computes: Factors an integer polynomial (sympy.factor_list), strips cyclotomic factors (Phi_n, n<=200), and returns (catalog_label, [(n,k)], match_type in direct_match / all_cyclotomic_match / composite_match / no_match) against the 8,625-entry Mossinghoff table; _cross_check recomputes M for a tier and returns mismatches > tol.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.databases.mahler import mahler_lookup_factored, _cross_check; mahler_lookup_factored([1,-3,2,1,0,-2,1,0,1,-2,0,1,2,-3,1]); _cross_check(tol=1e-9, tier="phase1_curated")`
inputs: integer coefficient list (high->low); MAHLER_TABLE loaded from databases/_known180_raw.gz at import
outputs: tuple (label|None, cyclotomic list, match_type); list of mismatch dicts
deps: sympy, techne.lib.mahler_measure (for _cross_check); update_mirror uses network -- avoid
evidence_of_execution: spec databases/MAHLER_FACTORED_LOOKUP_SPEC.md (2026-05-04); smoke: Lehmer x Phi_1^4 -> ("Lehmer's polynomial", [(1,4)], 'composite_match')
control: databases/tests/test_mahler_factored.py (14): Lehmer*Phi_1^4 composite (right), degenerate constant refused, random poly -> no_match (wrong case)
consumers: charon/agents/stygian/loaders/*, charon/agents/erebos (g24), pollux daemon, aporia stage0b corpus, prometheus_math/catalog_consistency.py
forensic_use: Decide whether a dead lane's "novel small-Mahler polynomial" was a catalog entry in disguise (cyclotomic padding was the historical cheat, see SILENT_SENTINEL_AUDIT.md 2026-05-07).
caveat: Catalog is 8,625 entries (178 curated + 8,431 Known180 + 16 arxiv_promoted); no_match means not-in-this-table, not new. SNAPSHOT_META in _mahler_data.py records the 2026-04-29 refresh as "calibration improvement, not a discovery".

name: catalog_consistency
kind: negative control / multi-catalog novelty check
computes: Runs 5 catalog adapters on (coeffs, M) and returns {by_catalog, any_hit, hits, unanimous_miss, errors}; unanimous_miss is explicitly documented as NOT a novelty proof.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.catalog_consistency import run_consistency_check; run_consistency_check(coeffs, m_value)`
deps: sympy; lmfdb/oeis/arxiv adapters use network (mossinghoff_check and lehmer_literature_check are local)
evidence_of_execution: consumed by charon/diagnostics/substrate_tester_fire_14_harness.py and arxiv_polynomial_probe.py; docs CATALOG_CONSISTENCY_USAGE.md, CATALOG_CONSISTENCY_NOTES.md
control: tests/test_catalog_consistency.py: Lehmer hits mossinghoff; random poly unanimous_miss; adapter error recorded in errors not as miss
forensic_use: Replay a dead lane's promoted "discoveries" through the local adapters offline (mossinghoff + lehmer_literature) to see how many were catalog hits at promotion time.
caveat: 3 of 5 adapters need network; offline they land in `errors`, and a careless reader may count errors as misses. Docs say unanimous_miss != novelty.

name: cross_machine_audit
kind: manifest/hash utility / provenance validator (neighbour of covered kill_vector.py)
computes: Deterministic hash of a KillVector (to_dict minus timestamp, components sorted by falsifier_name, SUBSTRATE_VERSION_FOR_AUDIT="v2.3.0", transformation chain recorded) and corpus-level comparison against a report produced on another machine.
invocation: `python -m prometheus_math.cross_machine_audit --kill-store PATH [--substrate-version v2.3.0] [--out REPORT.md]`
inputs: kill-vector store (JSON/JSONL as read by kill_vector loaders), optional remote report
outputs: markdown audit report with per-record hash agreement
evidence_of_execution: NONE FOUND -- no CROSS_MACHINE_AUDIT_RESULTS.md exists in the tree; never run end-to-end
control: tests/test_cross_machine_audit.py (26): same vector on reordered components hashes equal; timestamp change does not alter hash; substrate-version change does
forensic_use: Fingerprint a dead agent's KillVector corpus so a Necropolis re-audit on M2 can prove it is judging the same records the original agent produced (the certificates-must-fingerprint-inputs rule).
caveat: Pinned substrate version string; a kill store produced under a different KillVector schema version hashes fine but compares as all-different.

name: triangulation_independence_audit
kind: statistical test / negative control (neighbour of kill_vector.py)
computes: Pairwise mutual information between falsifier trigger flags across a KillVector store, against a random-pairing shuffle null (n_null=50), to decide whether "triangulated" kills were independent.
invocation: `python -m prometheus_math.triangulation_independence_audit [--store PATH] [--threshold 0.3] [--n-null 50] [--out REPORT.md]`
outputs: markdown report; dict of MI matrix + null quantiles
evidence_of_execution: prometheus_math/TRIANGULATION_AUDIT_RESULTS.md (2026-05-07): 24,000 records, only ONE active component, data is "first-fail-only-coded" -> no independence verdict possible
control: tests/test_triangulation_independence_audit.py: two identical flag columns -> MI above null; independent random columns -> within null
forensic_use: Exactly the "did the battery's members agree because they measured the same thing?" question; also a documented case of an instrument that ran and found the data shape could not answer it (a data-shape kill, not a finding).
caveat: A store that records only the first failing falsifier is structurally single-component; the audit will report "no verdict" and that is correct, not an error.

name: mutation_testing
kind: anti-cheat / test-strength scorer
computes: Proposes 4 mutation operators (comparison_flip, boolean_not, return_constant_None, off_by_one_int) on target source, rewrites the file, runs the given pytest command, and reports killed/survived and mutation score.
invocation: `python -m prometheus_math.mutation_testing --target-glob "sigma_kernel/operator_portability.py" --test-cmd "pytest sigma_kernel/tests -q" --max-mutations 10 --out MUTATION_TESTING_BASELINE.md`
inputs: python source files + a test command
import: IMPORTS (import only; NOT executed -- it rewrites target files and runs a test suite, both forbidden for this scout)
control: tests/test_mutation_testing.py (30): a test suite that asserts nothing lets every mutant survive; a real suite kills them
forensic_use: Measure whether a dead agent's tests could ever have caught a broken verifier (mutation score ~0 = the tests were decorative).
caveat: TEMPORARILY REWRITES the target file and shells out to pytest -- only run against a throwaway checkout, never the audit worktree.

name: withheld_benchmark
kind: replay harness / rediscovery benchmark (neighbour of covered discovery_pipeline.py)
computes: Holds out a seeded fraction of the Mossinghoff catalog, runs the discovery pipeline on the visible part, and scores how many withheld entries are rediscovered.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.withheld_benchmark import run_withheld_pilot; run_withheld_pilot(holdout_fraction=0.2, partition_seed=0)`
deps: prometheus_math.discovery_pipeline (may spin up its search; heavy)
evidence_of_execution: prometheus_math/WITHHELD_BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md (2026-04-29): 142 visible / 36 withheld, only 2 withheld in the sub-Lehmer band
control: partition is deterministic under partition_seed (test); no positive-rediscovery control on record
forensic_use: The template for "can the dead pipeline find things we know exist?" -- a withheld-rediscovery null for any catalog-driven discovery agent.
caveat: With only 2 withheld entries in the interesting band the benchmark had almost no power; the result doc says so. Runs the pipeline (CPU minutes); not a pure function.

name: kill_vector_learner_baselines
kind: grader / chance-floor baseline
computes: Fits global/region/operator/cell mean baselines for KillVector prediction and issues A_BEATS_CELL_MEAN / B_MATCHES_CELL_MEAN / C_UNDERPERFORMS_CELL_MEAN / C_REPRESENTATION_ISSUE (eps 0.005 on MAE) for a learner.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.kill_vector_learner import build_dataset, Baselines, _verdict_from_mae; ds = build_dataset(records); b = Baselines.fit(ds); _verdict_from_mae(learner_mae, cell_mae, region_mae)`
evidence_of_execution: prometheus_math/KILL_VECTOR_LEARNER_RESULTS.md + _kill_vector_learner_results.json (2026-05-04): verdict section explicitly "negative-but-not-broken", verdict B/C not representation bug
control: tests/test_kill_vector_learner.py (17): a learner that copies cell mean gets B; one below gets C; representation issue detected when features constant
forensic_use: The chance-floor grader pattern (memory: "Measurement carries its answer") -- apply to any dead learner's claimed predictive skill: did it beat the cell mean?
caveat: Verdict depends on eps=0.005 MAE; the underlying pilot data is binary first-fail-coded (see triangulation audit) so MAE is insensitive to margin.

name: kl_distinguishability
kind: scorer / coverage diagnostic
computes: Symmetric KL (Laplace eps 0.01) between operator-conditioned KillVector component distributions to say whether operators are distinguishable by their kill signatures; coverage_stats reports margin/component coverage of a store.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.native_kill_vector_pilot import kl_divergence_distinguishability, coverage_stats; kl_divergence_distinguishability(chart, use_squashed=False); coverage_stats(records)`
inputs: operator chart dict / list of KillVector records (JSON store)
deps: numpy; analyze()/rerun_day4_learner() pull in DiscoveryEnv/PPO (heavy; do not call)
evidence_of_execution: prometheus_math/_native_kill_vector_pilot.json (24K records) + NATIVE_KILL_VECTOR_PILOT_RESULTS.md (verdict B on the killer question, MAE table)
control: tests/test_native_kill_vector_pilot.py: identical charts KL=0; disjoint charts KL large
forensic_use: Given a dead agent's kill store, quantify whether its operators had distinguishable failure signatures (if not, "operator X caused the kills" is unsupported).
caveat: The pure functions are extractable; the module-level analyze() is a heavy pipeline. Laplace smoothing eps=0.01 dominates for small counts.

name: gradient_archaeology
kind: one-off audit script / corpus sampler (read-only over prometheus_math/_*.json)
computes: Aggregates the pilot JSON artefacts into six "gradients" (M distribution, Hamming nearest catalog entry, KL/JS/MI bits between regions and operators, verification depth) and labels each SIGNAL_PRESENT / SIGNAL_ABSENT / NEEDS_NEW_INSTRUMENTATION.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.gradient_archaeology import run_archaeology, write_artifacts; res = run_archaeology(); write_artifacts(res)  # write_artifacts writes into prometheus_math/ -- do not call in the audit worktree`
control: tests/test_gradient_archaeology.py: _kl_divergence_bits/_jensen_shannon_bits on known distributions; nearest_catalog_entry exact hit distance 0
forensic_use: Worked example of post-mortem archaeology on an archive with the organism stopped -- reads only artefacts; the SIGNAL_ABSENT / NEEDS_NEW_INSTRUMENTATION labels are the failure-shape vocabulary Necropolis wants.
caveat: 2,281 lines welded to the May pilot's JSON schema; the small information-theory helpers are reusable, the gradient functions are not.

name: lean_oracle
kind: symbolic oracle (Lean 4)
computes: Runs Lean 4 (toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.30.0) on a theorem source and returns LeanVerdict PROVED / REFUTED / ERROR; check_frozen_term guards against term drift; dependency_closure lists lemma deps.
invocation: `from prometheus_math.lean_oracle import lean_available, check_theorem; lean_available()  # False on this machine; check_theorem(src)`
deps: external `lean`/`lake` binary -- NOT available here (lean_available() False)
evidence_of_execution: consumed by techne canon_r9_lemma.py, canon_r10_analogy.py, aporia paradigm_p10_worked_example.py
control: tests/test_lean_oracle.py: PROVED on a trivial theorem, REFUTED on `1 = 2`, ERROR on syntax garbage (all skipped when lean absent)
forensic_use: Re-check any dead lane's "PROVED" claims with the same oracle -- but only on a machine with the toolchain (see agents/_shared/external_tools/lean_runtime, covered).
caveat: ERROR (toolchain/timeout) is three-valued and must not be read as REFUTED; on this host every call is ERROR.

name: canonicalizer_observability

name: pollux_spearman_pipeline
kind: statistical test / failure classifier (extractable functions inside a daemon)
computes: Spearman rank correlation of two value lists before and after mean-spacing normalization, then labels the pair as one of five kill-pattern strings (pollux_correlation_unmeasurable | pollux_sign_flips_under_normalization | pollux_correlation_survives_normalization | pollux_no_correlation_observed | pollux_correlation_attenuates_under_normalization).
invocation: python -c "from charon.agents.pollux.daemon import _spearman,_mean_spacing_normalize,_classify; r=_spearman(a,b); n=_spearman(_mean_spacing_normalize(a),_mean_spacing_normalize(b)); print(_classify(r,n))"
inputs: _spearman(xs: list[float], ys: list[float]) -> Optional[float] (returns None if n<10; ties broken by index, no tie correction); _mean_spacing_normalize(vs: list[float]) -> list[float] (sorts, returns consecutive gaps / mean gap, length n-1); _classify(corr_raw, corr_norm) -> str using CORR_SIGNIFICANT=0.30 and CORR_FLIPPED_DELTA=0.20 (L124-125). Daemon feeds it via _load_subset(spec) L127 which reads value columns from harmonia subset files.
outputs: float / list / label string; daemon wraps into a Theseus-schema kill_ledger row via _emit_kill_ledger_row (L276), record id from _record_id (L271).
deps: stdlib only (math, statistics, json). Daemon module imports charon.agents._base -> harmonia agent base.
import: IMPORTS (import creates nothing at import time; instantiating PolluxAgent mkdirs state/)
evidence_of_execution: NONE FOUND on this machine (ledger gitignored). Pollux verdicts referenced in charon/CHARON_SESSION_*.md and necropolis dossier (Rhadamanthus 2026-09-11 trial: Pollux 1/3 UNFAIR NO_FAIR_TEST_ON_RECORD).
control: NONE in repo. My synthetic one-liner: random unsorted lists -> raw -0.076; sorted-vs-sorted -> 1.000; normalized gaps -> -0.048; _classify -> "pollux_sign_flips_under_normalization" (i.e. pure noise is REJECTED as a sign flip). Two constant lists -> 1.0.
consumers: only the Pollux daemon itself (run_tick L386). No external importer.
forensic_use: Reproduce any Pollux kill row from its two input subsets and show whether the "sign flip" verdict is an artefact. Specifically: run_tick does `a_paired = sorted(a_vals)[:n]; b_paired = sorted(b_vals)[:n]` BEFORE calling _spearman, so the raw Spearman is 1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION for any two lists (sorted vs sorted), and every "kill" reduces to whether the gap-normalized correlation of two unrelated sorted sequences is below 0.30 -- which it almost always is. This is the smoking gun for Pollux's UNFAIR ruling and is testable without the daemon.
caveat: The pipeline is structurally invalid (sorted-vs-sorted pairing destroys the pairing the test assumes). Do not use the functions as a valid correlation instrument -- use them only to retrodict Pollux's own verdicts. _spearman has no tie handling.
